package server

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"hoardDB/storage"
	"hoardDB/transport"
)

// Throwaway: generates the pre-origin WAL fixture from the starting tree.
func TestZZGenerateLegacyFixture(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("FIXTURE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("FIXTURE_OUT not set")
	}
	tc := newTestCluster(t, 3, 3)
	defer tc.stop()

	tc.ok(0, transport.OpCreateDB, CreateDatabaseRequest{Name: testDatabase})
	tc.ok(0, transport.OpCreateBucket, CreateBucketRequest{Database: testDatabase, Name: testBucket, Type: BucketTypeFIFO})
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		frame := tc.ok(0, transport.OpFIFOPush, PushRequest{
			Database: testDatabase, Bucket: testBucket,
			Data: map[string]interface{}{"n": i}, WriteConcern: "all",
		})
		if frame.Opcode == transport.OpError {
			t.Fatalf("push %d: %s", i, frame.Payload)
		}
	}
	owner, err := tc.nodes[0].server.core.cluster.Owner(placementOf(testDatabase, testBucket))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	replicaIndex := -1
	for i := range tc.nodes {
		if tc.addrs[i] != owner.ID {
			replicaIndex = i
			break
		}
	}
	waitForWALSequence(t, tc.nodes[replicaIndex], 7)
	walDir := filepath.Join(tc.nodes[replicaIndex].cfg.Storage.DataDir, "wal")
	tc.stop()

	segment, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(walDir, "wal_00001.log"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "wal-segment-before-origin.bin"), segment, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	w, err := storage.OpenWAL(walDir, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	entries, err := w.ReadFrom(1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	type row struct {
		Seq    uint64 `json:"seq"`
		Op     byte   `json:"op"`
		Bucket string `json:"bucket"`
		Key    string `json:"key_hex"`
		Data   string `json:"data_hex"`
	}
	var rows []row
	for _, e := range entries {
		rows = append(rows, row{e.Seq, e.Op, e.Bucket, hex.EncodeToString(e.Key), hex.EncodeToString(e.Data)})
	}
	js, _ := json.MarshalIndent(rows, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "wal-segment-before-origin.json"), append(js, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("wrote %d bytes, %d entries from %s", len(segment), len(rows), walDir)
}
